subject: POC sprint snooze — SAML interop appeal and sandbox credit ask

Subject: Re: POC kickoff — SAML interoperability snag

Jonas / team,

Quick update from our side — our security team dug into the SAML flow and discovered that the IdP assertions our legacy service emits include a non-standard attribute block that breaks the connector. Our engineers are on it, but given internal priorities we won't have a fix until the end of next sprint (about 10 business days).

Given that, we're worried about losing momentum on the POC and hitting the demo window. Can Redwood provide a short sandbox top-up and a two-week trial extension so we can finish the auth work and validate end-to-end? We also have a tight procurement window and would like a simple statement of the extension terms to share with finance.

Attachments: SAML_spec_v2.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightWorks

Samir —

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the spec. I pulled in Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Sales Ops) to triage options. Totally get the situation — we prefer to keep momentum rather than pause the POC.

Immediate plan:
- Marissa: evaluate a one-off sandbox credit and temporary extension to the trial window.
- Engineering workaround: We can provide a short-lived test IdP (no production traffic) to validate the flow while your team fixes the assertion mapping.
- Documentation: I can provide a one-paragraph extension confirmation you can share with procurement.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm feasibility (credits + extension length) and any approvals needed? Ideally we keep this simple: small sandbox top-up + 14-day extension.
